on_screen_text.text: DONALD TRUMP RESPONDS TO A QUESTION ABOUT HIS HOARSE VOICE
Your voice sounds a little rough. Are you feeling all right?
I was shouting at people. I straightened it out, but I blew my stack.
It sounds like there's a follow-up there.
I thought you said there was a polyp.
